<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_WorkAccident" targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LabourInspectorate" name="Work accident report to Labour Inspectorate"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AccidentInsurance" name="Accident report to accident insurance provider"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Directorate" name="Accident report to competent directorate"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateInsurer" name="Written accident report to private insurer"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WorkAccident" name="Work Accident reporting process" processRef="Process_WorkAccident"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsurance" name="Responsible accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsurer" name="Private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LabourInspectorate" name="Report fatal or serious work accident" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate" messageRef="Message_LabourInspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerInsurance" name="Report qualifying work accident within five days" sourceRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance" messageRef="Message_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SelfEmployedInsurance" name="Report accidents involving self or employees" sourceRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance" messageRef="Message_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SchoolInsurance" name="Report in triplicate within five days" sourceRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance" messageRef="Message_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Directorate" name="Report accident to competent directorate" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Participant_Directorate" messageRef="Message_Directorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateInsurerImmediate" name="Immediate written accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer" messageRef="Message_PrivateInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateInsurerFatal" name="Fatality report within three days" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateFatality" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer" messageRef="Message_PrivateInsurer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkAccident" name="Work Accident" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Incident" name="Accident or safety concern identified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherInformation" name="Gather accident circumstances">
      <bpmn:documentation>Record information relevant to whether the event is covered and to the applicable reporting duties. For insured gainful employment, examples include an accident at a place, time and with a cause connected to the employment; working from home; direct journeys between residence, work, lunch or home (including carpools); qualifying professional training and journeys to or from training; notified visits to a doctor on the stated routes; journeys for taking a supervised child to or collecting them from childcare, daycare, external care or school; and use of advocacy groups or professional associations. For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, examples include circumstances connected to the insured education or compulsory kindergarten year; school or school-related events; direct journeys between residence or permanent accommodation and kindergarten or school; curriculum or study-regulation practical tasks; and certain professional training orientations. Agricultural and forestry coverage can also include household work serving the establishment to a considerable extent, guest accommodation, secondary sales of farm products, construction or repair of buildings serving the establishment, and neighbourhood assistance for another such establishment. Accidents outside professional activity may also be treated as work accidents, including activities using services under the Unemployment Insurance Act or Labor Market Promotion Act, assistance at an accident or blood donation, and specified training, exercises or service with the listed volunteer aid organisations.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" name="Select applicable reporting duties"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EmployeeNotifyEmployer" name="Inform employer immediately"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployerDuties" name="Check employer reporting duties"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InspectorateEligibility" name="Fatality or serious injury?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmergencyReported" name="Already reported to emergency services?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInspectorate" name="Report to Labour Inspectorate immediately"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InspectorateMerge" name="Continue employer reporting"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance" name="Report qualifying accident to accident insurance within five days"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployerDutiesJoin" name="Complete applicable employer reports"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance" name="Ensure timely accident insurance report for self or employees"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportDirectorate" name="Report accident to competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance" name="Report school accident to accident insurance in triplicate within five days"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer" name="Report accident to private insurer in writing immediately"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateFatality" name="Fatality?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportPrivateFatality" name="Report fatality to private insurer within three days"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateMerge" name="Complete private insurance reporting"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin" name="Complete applicable reporting duties"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReportingComplete" name="Applicable reporting duties completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Gather" sourceRef="StartEvent_Incident" targetRef="Task_GatherInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gather_Routes" sourceRef="Task_GatherInformation" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_Employee" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_EmployeeNotifyEmployer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Employee work accident, near miss, discovered serious and immediate safety or health risk, or discovered defect in a protection system</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_SelfEmployed" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Self-employed person has an accident involving themself or a person they employ</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_Student" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportDirectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Student or schoolchild accident requiring report to the competent directorate</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_School" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">School, educational facility or university accident physically injures or kills a person with accident insurance</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_Private" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Private insurance applies to the accident</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_EmployerDuties" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeNotifyEmployer" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerDuties_Inspectorate" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties" targetRef="Gateway_InspectorateEligibility">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Accident leads to a fatality or serious injury</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerDuties_Insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties" targetRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Work accident kills a person with accident insurance or causes such injury that the person is unable to work for at least three days, in full or in part</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectorateEligibility_EmergencyCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_InspectorateEligibility" targetRef="Gateway_EmergencyReported">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Yes</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmergencyReported_Inspectorate" sourceRef="Gateway_EmergencyReported" targetRef="Gateway_InspectorateMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Yes, already reported to emergency services</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmergencyNotReported_Inspectorate" sourceRef="Gateway_EmergencyReported" targetRef="Task_ReportInspectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">No, not reported to emergency services</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectorateReport_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Gateway_InspectorateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectorateMerge_DutiesJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_InspectorateMerge" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerDutiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerInsurance_DutiesJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerDutiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerDutiesJoin_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDutiesJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Directorate_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolInsurance_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_Report_FatalityCheck" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatality_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="Task_ReportPrivateFatality">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Fatality</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatality_No" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">No fatality</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatalityReport_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateFatality" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateMerge_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RoutesJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_ReportingComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkAccident" targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LabourInspectorate" name="Work accident report to Labour Inspectorate"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AccidentInsurance" name="Accident report to accident insurance provider"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Directorate" name="Accident report to competent directorate"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateInsurer" name="Written accident report to private insurer"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WorkAccident" name="Work Accident reporting process" processRef="Process_WorkAccident"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsurance" name="Responsible accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsurer" name="Private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LabourInspectorate" name="Report fatal or serious work accident immediately" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate" messageRef="Message_LabourInspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerInsurance" name="Report qualifying work accident within five days" sourceRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance" messageRef="Message_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SelfEmployedInsurance" name="Report accidents involving self or employees in good time" sourceRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance" messageRef="Message_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SchoolInsurance" name="Report in triplicate within five days" sourceRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance" messageRef="Message_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Directorate" name="Report accident to competent directorate" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Participant_Directorate" messageRef="Message_Directorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateInsurerImmediate" name="Immediate written accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer" messageRef="Message_PrivateInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateInsurerFatal" name="Fatality report within three days" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateFatality" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer" messageRef="Message_PrivateInsurer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkAccident" name="Work Accident" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Incident" name="Accident or safety concern identified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherInformation" name="Gather accident circumstances and identify applicable reporting duties">
      <bpmn:documentation>For insured gainful employment, gather information about whether the accident occurred at a location, time and with a cause connected to the insured employment; while working from home; on the direct route between residence and work, lunch or home, including carpools; during qualifying professional training or travel to or from its centre; during a doctor visit on the stated routes, where the visit was notified to the employer in advance; while taking a supervised child to or collecting them from childcare, daycare, external care or school on the way to or from work or training; or when making use of advocacy groups or professional associations. For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, gather information about whether the accident was connected to the insured education or compulsory kindergarten year; occurred at a school or school-related event; occurred on the direct route between residence or permanent accommodation and kindergarten or school; occurred while performing a practical task prescribed by the curriculum or study regulations; or occurred during a professional training orientation. For agricultural or forestry establishments, covered circumstances can also include household work that serves the establishment to a considerable extent, guest accommodation, secondary sales of farm products, construction or repair of buildings serving the establishment, and neighbourhood assistance for another agricultural or forestry establishment. Accidents outside professional activity may also be treated as work accidents, including activities using services under the Unemployment Insurance Act or Labor Market Promotion Act, assisting at an accident or donating blood, and training, exercises or service with the listed volunteer aid organisations: volunteer fire brigade, volunteer water rescue service, volunteer rescue organisations, Austrian Red Cross, Austrian Alpine Rescue Service, Austrian Water Rescue, Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade, avalanche warning committees, air rescue service, and radiation detection and survey crews.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" name="Select applicable reporting duties"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmployeeNotifyEmployer" name="Inform employer immediately of the accident, near miss, serious immediate risk or protection-system defect"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployerDuties" name="Select applicable employer reports"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmergencyReported" name="Already reported to emergency services?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInspectorate" name="Report fatal or serious work accident to Labour Inspectorate immediately"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InspectorateMerge" name="Continue employer reporting"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance" name="Report qualifying work accident to accident insurance within five days"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployerDutiesJoin" name="Complete applicable employer reports"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance" name="Ensure timely accident insurance report for self or employees"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportDirectorate" name="Report student or schoolchild accident to competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance" name="Report school accident to accident insurance in triplicate within five days"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer" name="Report accident to private insurer in writing immediately"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateFatality" name="Fatality?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportPrivateFatality" name="Report fatality to private insurer within three days, even if the accident was already reported"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateMerge" name="Complete private insurance reporting"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin" name="Complete applicable reporting duties"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReportingComplete" name="Applicable reporting duties completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Gather" sourceRef="StartEvent_Incident" targetRef="Task_GatherInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gather_Routes" sourceRef="Task_GatherInformation" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_Employee" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_EmployeeNotifyEmployer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">An employee has a work accident, near miss, discovered serious and immediate safety or health risk, or discovered defect in a protection system</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_SelfEmployed" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A self-employed person has an accident involving themself or a person they employ</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_Student" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportDirectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The injured person is a student or schoolchild who should report the accident to the competent directorate</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_School" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A school, educational facility or university accident physically injures or kills a person with accident insurance</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_Private" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Private insurance applies to the accident</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_EmployerDuties" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeNotifyEmployer" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerDuties_Inspectorate" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties" targetRef="Gateway_EmergencyReported">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The work accident leads to a fatality or serious injury</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerDuties_Insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties" targetRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A person with accident insurance has been killed or injured so that they are unable to work for three days, in full or in part</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerDuties_Bypass" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerDutiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmergencyReported_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_EmergencyReported" targetRef="Gateway_InspectorateMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Yes, already reported to emergency services</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmergencyReported_No" sourceRef="Gateway_EmergencyReported" targetRef="Task_ReportInspectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">No, not reported to emergency services</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectorateReport_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Gateway_InspectorateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectorateMerge_DutiesJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_InspectorateMerge" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerDutiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerInsurance_DutiesJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerDutiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerDutiesJoin_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDutiesJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Directorate_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolInsurance_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_Report_FatalityCheck" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatality_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="Task_ReportPrivateFatality">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A fatality occurred</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatality_No" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">No fatality occurred</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatalityReport_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateFatality" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateMerge_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RoutesJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_ReportingComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

For insured gainful employment, examples include an accident at a location, time and with a cause connected to the insured employment; working from home; the direct route from permanent residence to work, to lunch or home, including carpools; professional training that provides specific professional knowledge and journeys to or from its centre; a notified visit to a doctor on the stated routes; journeys to take a child to or collect them from childcare, daycare, external care or school where the person has supervisory responsibility; and use of advocacy groups or professional associations. For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, examples include circumstances connected to the insured education or compulsory kindergarten year; school or school-related events; the direct route between residence or permanent accommodation and kindergarten or school; practical tasks prescribed by the curriculum or study regulations; and certain professional training orientations. In agricultural or forestry establishments, coverage can include household work serving the establishment to a considerable extent, guest accommodation, secondary sales of farm products, construction, conversion or repair of buildings serving the establishment, and neighbourhood assistance for another such establishment. Accidents outside professional activity may also be considered work accidents, including activities using services under the Unemployment Insurance Act or Labor Market Promotion Act, assistance at an accident or blood donation, and training, exercises or service with the listed volunteer aid organisations: volunteer fire brigade, volunteer water rescue service, volunteer rescue organisations, Austrian Red Cross, Austrian Alpine Rescue Service, Austrian Water Rescue, Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade, avalanche warning committees, air rescue service, and radiation detection and survey crews.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" name="Select applicable reporting duties"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EmployeeNotifyEmployer" name="Inform employer immediately"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployerDuties" name="Select applicable employer reports"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmergencyReported" name="Already reported to emergency services?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInspectorate" name="Report fatal or serious work accident to Labour Inspectorate immediately"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance" name="Report qualifying work accident to accident insurance within five days"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployerDutiesJoin" name="Complete applicable employer reports"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance" name="Ensure timely accident insurance report for self or employees"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportDirectorate" name="Report student or schoolchild accident to competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance" name="Report qualifying school accident to accident insurance in triplicate within five days"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer" name="Report accident to private insurer in writing immediately"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateFatality" name="Fatality?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportPrivateFatality" name="Report fatality to private insurer within three days"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateMerge" name="Complete private insurance reporting"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin" name="Complete applicable reporting duties"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReportingComplete" name="Applicable reporting duties completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoReportingRoute" name="No listed reporting duty applies"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Gather" sourceRef="StartEvent_Incident" targetRef="Task_GatherInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gather_Routes" sourceRef="Task_GatherInformation" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_Employee" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_EmployeeNotifyEmployer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">An employee has a work accident, an incident that almost led to an accident, a discovered serious and immediate safety or health risk, or a discovered defect in a protection system.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_SelfEmployed" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A self-employed person has an accident involving themself or a person they employ.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_Student" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportDirectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A student or schoolchild has an accident to report to the competent directorate.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_School" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A school, educational facility or university has a work accident in which a person with accident insurance is physically injured or killed.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_Private" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Private insurance applies to the accident.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_None" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="EndEvent_NoReportingRoute">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">None of the listed reporting routes applies.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_EmployerDuties" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeNotifyEmployer" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerDuties_Inspectorate" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties" targetRef="Gateway_EmergencyReported">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The work accident leads to a fatality or serious injury and has not already been reported to emergency services.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmergencyReported_Inspectorate" sourceRef="Gateway_EmergencyReported" targetRef="Task_ReportInspectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">No, it has not been reported to emergency services.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmergencyAlreadyReported" sourceRef="Gateway_EmergencyReported" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerDutiesJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Yes, it has already been reported to emergency services.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectorateReport_EmployerJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerDutiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerDuties_Insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties" targetRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A work accident has killed a person with accident insurance or caused an injury that makes the person unable to work for three days, in full or in part.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerDuties_None" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerDutiesJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Neither an immediate Labour Inspectorate report nor a five-day accident insurance report is required.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerInsurance_EmployerJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerDutiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerJoin_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDutiesJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Directorate_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolInsurance_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_Report_FatalityCheck" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatality_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="Task_ReportPrivateFatality">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A fatality occurred.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatality_No" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">No fatality occurred.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatalityReport_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateFatality" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateMerge_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RoutesJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_ReportingComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkAccident" targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LabourInspectorate" name="Report to Labour Inspectorate"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AccidentInsurance" name="Report to accident insurance provider"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Directorate" name="Report to competent directorate"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateInsurer" name="Report to private insurance provider"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WorkAccident" name="Work Accident information and reporting" processRef="Process_WorkAccident"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsurance" name="Responsible accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsurer" name="Private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LabourInspectorate" name="Fatal or serious work accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate" messageRef="Message_LabourInspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_QualifyingInsurance" name="Qualifying work accident report within five days" sourceRef="Task_ReportQualifyingInsurance" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance" messageRef="Message_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SelfEmployedInsurance" name="Timely report for self-employed person or employees" sourceRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance" messageRef="Message_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SchoolInsurance" name="School accident report in triplicate within five days" sourceRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance" messageRef="Message_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Directorate" name="Student or schoolchild accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Participant_Directorate" messageRef="Message_Directorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateImmediate" name="Immediate written accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer" messageRef="Message_PrivateInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateFatality" name="Fatality report within three days" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateFatality" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer" messageRef="Message_PrivateInsurer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkAccident" name="Work Accident" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Incident" name="Accident or safety concern identified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherInformation" name="Gather accident information">
      <bpmn:documentation>Gather information about the accident or near accident, its circumstances, and the people involved. For insured gainful employment, relevant examples include an accident at a location, time and with a cause connected to the insured employment; working from home; the direct route between permanent residence and work, lunch or home, including carpools; professional training that provides specific professional knowledge and travel to or from its centre; a doctor visit notified to the employer in advance that interrupts the specified direct route; travel to take a child to or collect them from childcare, daycare, external care or school where the person has supervisory responsibility; and use of advocacy groups or professional associations. For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, examples include circumstances connected to the insured education or compulsory kindergarten year; school or school-related events; the direct route between residence or permanent accommodation and kindergarten or school; practical tasks prescribed by the curriculum or study regulations; and certain professional training orientations. In agricultural or forestry establishments, covered circumstances can include household work that serves the establishment to a considerable extent, guest accommodation, secondary sales of farm products, construction, conversion or repair of buildings serving the establishment, and neighbourhood assistance for another such establishment. Accidents outside professional activity may also be considered work accidents, including activities using services under the Unemployment Insurance Act or Labor Market Promotion Act, assistance at an accident or blood donation, and training, exercises or service with the listed aid organisations: volunteer fire brigade, volunteer water rescue service, volunteer rescue organisations, Austrian Red Cross, Austrian Alpine Rescue Service, Austrian Water Rescue, Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade, avalanche warning committees, air rescue service, and radiation detection and survey crews.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" name="Select applicable reporting duties" default="Flow_Routes_None"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EmployeeNotifyEmployer" name="Employee informs employer immediately"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InspectorateDecision" name="Fatal or serious accident not reported to emergency services?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInspectorate" name="Employer reports fatal or serious work accident to Labour Inspectorate immediately"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InspectorateMerge" name="Continue after Labour Inspectorate decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployerInsuranceDecision" name="Insured person killed or unable to work for three days?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportQualifyingInsurance" name="Report qualifying work accident to accident insurance provider within five days"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployerInsuranceMerge" name="Continue after five-day reporting decision"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance" name="Self-employed person ensures timely report for accidents involving themself or employees"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportDirectorate" name="Student or schoolchild reports accident to competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance" name="School, educational facility or university reports insured person's physical injury or death in triplicate within five days"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer" name="Insured party reports accident to private insurer in writing immediately"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateFatalityDecision" name="Fatality under private insurance?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportPrivateFatality" name="Report fatality to private insurer within three days, even if already reported"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateMerge" name="Complete private insurance reporting"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin" name="Complete applicable reporting duties"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReportingComplete" name="Applicable reporting duties completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoReportingRoute" name="No listed reporting duty applies"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Gather" sourceRef="StartEvent_Incident" targetRef="Task_GatherInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gather_Routes" sourceRef="Task_GatherInformation" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_Employee" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_EmployeeNotifyEmployer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">An employee has a work accident, an incident that almost led to an accident, a serious and immediate risk to safety and health, or a defect in a protection system.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_QualifyingInsurance" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportQualifyingInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A person with accident insurance was killed or injured so as to be unable to work for three days, in full or in part.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_SelfEmployed" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A self-employed person has an accident involving themself or a person they employ.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_Directorate" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportDirectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The accident concerns a student or schoolchild who should report it to the competent directorate.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_SchoolInsurance" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A school, educational facility or university has a work accident in which a person with accident insurance is physically injured or killed.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_Private" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Private insurance applies to the accident.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_None" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="EndEvent_NoReportingRoute"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_InspectorateDecision" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeNotifyEmployer" targetRef="Gateway_InspectorateDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspectorate_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InspectorateDecision" targetRef="Task_ReportInspectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The work accident leads to a fatality or serious injury and has not been reported to emergency services.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspectorate_No" sourceRef="Gateway_InspectorateDecision" targetRef="Gateway_InspectorateMerge" name="Otherwise"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectorateReport_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Gateway_InspectorateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectorateMerge_InsuranceDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_InspectorateMerge" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerInsuranceDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerInsurance_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerInsuranceDecision" targetRef="Task_ReportQualifyingInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A person with accident insurance was killed or injured so as to be unable to work for three days, in full or in part.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerInsurance_No" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerInsuranceDecision" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerInsuranceMerge" name="Otherwise"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerInsuranceReport_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReportQualifyingInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerInsuranceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerInsuranceMerge_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerInsuranceMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Directorate_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolInsurance_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_FatalityDecision" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateFatalityDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatality_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatalityDecision" targetRef="Task_ReportPrivateFatality">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A fatality occurred.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatality_No" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatalityDecision" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateMerge" name="Otherwise"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatalityReport_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateFatality" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateMerge_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RoutesJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_ReportingComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
